paragraphs: Menaḥem: Issi ben Menaḥem; R. Ilai ben Menaḥem; R. Elazar ben Menaḥem; Menashya ben Menaḥem. [Glosses: Menaḥem. (a) Ḥelek 108a: R. Menaḥem bar Yosef; perhaps it should read Yose; not corrected. (b) Mo'ed Katan 25b: R. Menaḥem son of R. Yose; Ein Yaakov reads 'son of R. Simai,' and so it should read; not corrected.]
